channel.title: LaunchNotes incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from LaunchNotes's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Notifications sent using the LaunchNotes email service provider may not be delivered on time [resolved]
Announcement content changes not persisting [resolved]
item.description: We recently made changes to our GitOps process to further improve how we deliver software. As part of that change, we introduced a small bug that broke name resolution between our core service and our content service. This resulted in content changes not showing on our public pages. We implemented and deployed a fix and have confirmed all content persistence and caching is functioning correctly.

item.title: Services are unresponsive [resolved]
item.description: Our database experienced an increased write load which brought several services off line. We identified the problem and implemented a fix to resolve the immediate outage and prevent this class of incident from happening again in the future.

item.title: Customer pages experiencing TLS errors when loading [resolved]
